name: KAREN
source:
Main character meets a young girl in the school courtyard. She makes him feel closer to death in a strange way. She makes him experience sex like never before. In this whirlpool of Eros and Thanatos the city itself forms an invisible "cage" to isolate them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
